content: Suresh Deshmukh from Secure Life Solutions calls Aditya Singh to discuss the upcoming expiration of his health policy on 15/10/2026. Aditya is hesitant and unsure if he wants to renew. After Suresh explains the loss of inpatient, outpatient, and pre-existing condition benefits upon expiration, Aditya expresses concern and asks for a summary of lost coverage. Suresh offers to email him the renewal quotes as a next step.

action_items: Email renewal quotes to the customer
